description: This file defines a React component for a Sessions dashboard page, including server-side search, pagination, data fetching, and visualization components such as charts and a data table.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case keys to Title Case labels.

methods.name: buildRestrictedColumns
methods.description: Builds DataTable columns based on allowed fields, preserving order.

methods.name: loadAggregates
methods.description: Fetches session data across multiple pages and builds client-side aggregates for charts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads session data from server with pagination, optional search query, and sorting.
